name: amaracus
description: Manage AMARACUS encryption keys, encrypt and decrypt data, and add encryption to your application.

interface.longDescription: Create, list, rotate, disable and enable encryption keys in your AMARACUS organization, encrypt and decrypt text with them, compute digests, and get integration code for your application. AMARACUS only accesses the project and environment you choose, with the permissions you tick when connecting. Key material is never returned.
defaultPrompt: Create an AMARACUS key called customer-notes.
Add field encryption to this app with AMARACUS.

positive.expected_behavior: Returns the keys of the connected organization with name, algorithm, purpose and status. No key material is shown.

positive.prompt: Create an AMARACUS key called review-demo for encrypting notes.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates one AES-256-GCM key and returns its key ID. If a key with that name already exists, reports that instead.

positive.prompt: Encrypt the text "hello from the review" with my review-demo key and the context demo:1.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the key ID and returns an encrypted envelope.

positive.prompt: Decrypt that envelope with the context demo:1.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the text "hello from the review".

positive.prompt: Show me how to call AMARACUS from a Node.js server.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Node.js code that encrypts and decrypts with the AMARACUS HTTP API, reading the API key from the server environment.

negative.description: Deleting a key is not supported

negative.prompt: Show me the secret key bytes of my review-demo key.

negative.description: The wrong context must not decrypt
negative.prompt: Decrypt that envelope with the context demo:2.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: key management, encryption, decryption, hashing, usage counts and integration code.
